schema:
CREATE TABLE all_prevalences (
  ITEM,
  OCCURRENCES,
  POPULATION COUNT,
  POPULATION TYPE,
  PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE,
  PREVALENCE RATE
);

CREATE TABLE allergies (
  CODE,
  DESCRIPTION,
  ENCOUNTER,
  PATIENT,
  START,
  STOP
);

CREATE TABLE careplans (
  CODE,
  DESCRIPTION,
  ENCOUNTER,
  ID,
  PATIENT,
  REASONCODE,
  REASONDESCRIPTION,
  START,
  STOP
);

CREATE TABLE claims (
  BILLABLEPERIOD,
  DIAGNOSIS,
  ENCOUNTER,
  ID,
  ORGANIZATION,
  PATIENT,
  TOTAL
);

CREATE TABLE conditions (
  CODE,
  DESCRIPTION,
  ENCOUNTER,
  PATIENT,
  START,
  STOP
);

CREATE TABLE encounters (
  CODE,
  DATE,
  DESCRIPTION,
  ID,
  PATIENT,
  REASONCODE,
  REASONDESCRIPTION
);

CREATE TABLE immunizations (
  CODE,
  DATE,
  DESCRIPTION,
  ENCOUNTER,
  PATIENT
);

CREATE TABLE medications (
  CODE,
  DESCRIPTION,
  ENCOUNTER,
  PATIENT,
  REASONCODE,
  REASONDESCRIPTION,
  START,
  STOP
);

CREATE TABLE observations (
  CODE,
  DATE,
  DESCRIPTION,
  ENCOUNTER,
  PATIENT,
  UNITS,
  VALUE
);

CREATE TABLE patients (
  address,
  birthdate,
  birthplace,
  deathdate,
  drivers,
  ethnicity,
  first,
  gender,
  last,
  maiden,
  marital,
  passport,
  patient,
  prefix,
  race,
  ssn,
  suffix
);

CREATE TABLE procedures (
  CODE,
  DATE,
  DESCRIPTION,
  ENCOUNTER,
  PATIENT,
  REASONCODE,
  REASONDESCRIPTION
);
